role: C04 bounded individual contextual source review
decision: The upstream patch replaces the CDK sticky mixin with transformed inputs and explicit changed-state tracking and updates modern Material metadata. Material 16 legacy row and column directives exposed historical sticky inputs; its CDK mixin and stickyEnd setters coerce on each assignment and reset the change flag to whether that assignment changed the value. Current owned legacy directives retain the historical input metadata and wrap peer setters with coerceBooleanProperty and resetStickyChanged. Retain these local adaptations rather than substitute the modern Material metadata. The peer still owns the underlying setters and sticky rendering; neither exact input/change-state behavior nor native/flex updates has been executed here. Test empty and false strings, direct and template writes, unchanged and successive sticky/stickyEnd writes, reset/read behavior, and rendered sticky updates.
